top_signals.title: Gold Rebounds as Dip-Buyers Step In After Worst Week Since March
top_signals.summary: Gold jumped, rebounding from its biggest weekly decline in eight months, with dip-buyers stepping in as the market pared bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in December.

top_signals.summary: Risk-averse investors are moving further away from crypto products as they expect the another interest rate hike in December, analysts said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Slide as AI Bubble Fears Rattle Global Markets
top_signals.summary: A stock selloff driven by doubts about the economic growth potential of artificial intelligence infected commodities, too, dragging crude oil prices down today despite continued tanker attacks in the Persian Gulf. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $92.55 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $83.45 per barrel. Both were down from the opening of trade in Asia, but they were both higher than their Friday close, suggesting the effect of the stock selloff was limited in energy commodities.
